title: Find All Anagrams in a String
description:
Given lowercase strings s and p, find every starting index in s where a substring is a rearrangement of p. Return the indices in ascending order. Overlapping matches count separately.

A match has exactly the same character counts as p. Instead of counting each candidate substring from scratch, update the counts of a fixed-length window as one character enters and another leaves.

Example 1:

Input: s = "cbaebabacd", p = "abc"
Output: [0,6]

Example 2:

Input: s = "abab", p = "ab"
Output: [0,1,2]

Example 3:

Input: s = "aaaa", p = "aa"
Output: [0,1,2]

Constraints:

  • 1 <= s.length, p.length <= 30,000
  • Both strings consist only of lowercase English letters.
  • If p is longer than s, return an empty list.

exampleTestCases.explanation: The substrings at indices 0 and 6 contain a, b, and c once each.
Three length-two windows contain one a and one b.
Each pair of adjacent a's matches, including overlaps.
